summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans two complementary layers: model repositories like Hugging Face that host weights, datasets, and code for community distribution, and developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running those models easy via local runtimes or hosted APIs. As of 2026 the Hugging Face Hub has crossed 3 million public models, with a highly skewed download distribution (the top 200 models account for roughly half of all downloads) and a shift toward Chinese open-weight labs (Moonshot, MiniMax, Qwen, DeepSeek, Z.ai) leading in both download volume and model scale. These open hubs and inference APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI).

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints for deployment.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, growing by ~1M+ per year)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited serverless inference; Pro subscription (~$9/mo); pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise Hub plans per seat
features: Massive model, dataset, and Spaces hosting with Git-based version control
Transformers, Datasets, and Diffusers libraries integration
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints (autoscaling GPU)
Download statistics, model cards, leaderboards, and community discussions
Supports multiple formats (PyTorch, Safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, TensorFlow)
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open-source developers needing the broadest model/dataset catalog, experimentation, and flexible deployment options

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that makes downloading and running open LLMs on personal hardware (Mac, Windows, Linux) simple via a single CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, etc.), plus thousands of community GGUF variants importable from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free and open source for local use; optional Ollama Cloud for hosted/larger-model inference (usage-based)
features: One-command model download and run with automatic quantization handling
Local OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy app integration
Cross-platform desktop support with GPU acceleration
Modelfile system for customizing prompts, parameters, and system messages
Offline, privacy-preserving inference with no data leaving the device
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, free, local inference and rapid prototyping without cloud dependencies

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and sharing open models (especially image, video, audio, and multimodal) via a simple API, with easy custom model deployment using Cog.
platforms.model_count: Tens of thousands of community-published models and versions
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no subscription required
features: Run thousands of community models via a single consistent API
Cog packaging tool for deploying custom models as containers
Strong focus on generative media (Stable Diffusion, FLUX, video, TTS)
Automatic scaling and cold-start handling
Webhooks, streaming, and fine-tuning support
platforms.best_for: Application developers who want to integrate generative/multimodal models quickly without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs and dedicated GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (priced by model size); dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token/job
features: Fast serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Dedicated endpoints and on-demand GPU clusters (H100/H200)
Broad catalog of leading open-weight chat, code, and image models
Batch inference and high-throughput optimizations
platforms.best_for: Startups and teams building production LLM apps on open models that need scalable, low-cost token-based inference and training

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open LLMs, vision, and audio models, emphasizing low latency and production throughput with its FireAttention engine.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (by model size); on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning available
features: FireAttention-optimized high-speed inference
OpenAI-compatible API and function/tool calling
Fine-tuning and LoRA adapter serving
Multimodal support (text, vision, audio, embeddings)
Dedicated deployments for enterprise throughput and SLAs
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing the lowest-latency, high-throughput serving of open models in production

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud (strong presence in China) offering fast, cost-efficient access to open-weight LLMs, image, and audio models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models, with deep coverage of leading Chinese open-weight models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM/Z.ai, MiniMax, Kimi/Moonshot)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing with a free tier for select models; dedicated/reserved instances available
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Strong catalog of top Chinese open-weight models
Image, audio, and embedding model support alongside LLMs
Competitive, low-cost token pricing
Fast inference optimizations and scalable deployment
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asian markets) wanting affordable access to cutting-edge Chinese open-weight models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely fast token generation for popular open-weight LLMs via an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek distillations, Mixtral, Gemma)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise and on-prem options
features: Industry-leading inference speed via custom LPU hardware
OpenAI-compatible API and tool calling
Low, predictable per-token pricing
Focus on a curated set of high-demand open models
Real-time and agentic use-case optimization
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive and real-time applications needing the fastest open-model inference

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models across dozens of providers (open-weight and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through pay-per-token pricing with a small markup; credit-based prepaid billing; some free models
features: Single API key for many models and providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency/availability
Transparent per-model pricing and usage analytics
OpenAI-compatible interface for easy switching
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access and easy comparison/switching between many models
